tools.name: addToCart
tools.description: Add a rug variant to the cart by the variantId from searchRugs/getRugDetails. Which dimensions to supply depends on the variant's `type` (read it from the search/detail result): type 'normal' -> supply NEITHER widthCm nor lengthCm (fixed size); type 'meter' -> supply lengthCm ONLY (width is fixed by the variant's roll width; any widthCm is ignored); type 'kvadratmeter' -> supply BOTH widthCm and lengthCm, EXCEPT a round variant (sizeLabel 'rund') -> supply widthCm ONLY (length equals width). For made-to-order types, keep dimensions within the variant's `constraints` from getRugDetails. The server ALWAYS re-validates: a variant that searchRugs reported inStock:true may still be rejected, so success is never guaranteed before the call. On success returns { success:true, added, cart } (cart = the full updated cart, same shape as getCart). On failure returns { success:false, error } where error is one of: 'unknown_variant' (no such variant), 'out_of_stock' (variant flagged unavailable), 'insufficient_stock' (fewer in stock than requested quantity — try a smaller quantity or another variant), 'quantity_out_of_range' (quantity must be an integer 1–99), 'invalid_dimensions' (missing/out-of-bounds widthCm/lengthCm for the type), or 'internal_error'. Clients can react to the typed error (e.g. on insufficient_stock, pick a different variant).

variantId.description: The variantId from a search or detail result.

quantity.description: Number of units to add (integer 1–99). Defaults to 1.

widthCm.description: Desired width in cm. Supply only for type 'kvadratmeter' (both dims) or a round kvadratmeter variant (this alone). Ignored for 'meter'; omit for 'normal'.

lengthCm.description: Desired length in cm. Supply for type 'meter' (this alone) and non-round 'kvadratmeter'. Omit for 'normal' and round variants.

tools.name: browseCollections
tools.description: Browse OR navigate to store collections. Set navigate=true whenever the user wants to be taken to a collection page in the browser (triggers: "browse to", "go to", "show me", "open", "take me to", "navigate to" a collection or category). With navigate=false (default), returns collection or product data without changing the page — use this only when the user is asking a question about the catalog, not asking to view it. Without a collection handle, lists all collections. With a handle, returns products from that collection. Does NOT add anything to the cart; use addToCart for cart changes. Prefer this over searchRugs when the user names a category, collection, or wants to explore. When navigate=true succeeds the browser is ALREADY on the collection page — do NOT navigate again by ANY means (no other webmcp tool; no other host tool that changes the page URL, opens a URL, loads a page, or fetches a page, regardless of its name; no constructing or retyping URLs yourself) and do NOT tell the user to click links to get there; just answer them referencing the returned url exactly as given.

handle.description: The collection slug or category name (e.g. the slug of a menu entry). Omit to list all collections.

navigate.description: When true, navigate the browser to the collection page. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: getCart
tools.description: Read the current shopping cart: line items with per-line ex/inc-VAT prices and the ex/inc-VAT subtotals in SEK.

tools.name: getRugDetails
tools.description: Get full detail for a single rug by its slug (from a searchRugs result): description, careInstructions, images, and all variants (in-stock filtering off, so every variant is listed). Each variant has: variantId (opaque id to pass to addToCart); type ('normal' = fixed-size, buy as-is; 'meter' = cut-to-length off a fixed-width roll; 'kvadratmeter' = cut to a custom width×length); colorName; sizeLabel (for normal: 'W x L cm'; for meter: a bare number = the roll width in cm; for kvadratmeter: descriptive, may be 'rund' for round); widthCm/lengthCm (numbers for normal, null for made-to-order since the size is chosen at addToCart); priceExVat and priceIncVat in SEK; currency; inStock (boolean); stockQty (a number, or null meaning quantity is untracked / made-to-order — null means AVAILABLE, not unavailable). Made-to-order variants also carry `constraints` = { width: { min, max }, length: { min, max } } in cm (a null bound = unbounded) — the valid range for the widthCm/lengthCm you pass to addToCart. For made-to-order variants (type 'meter'/'kvadratmeter'), each variant also carries `constraints` = { width: { min, max }, length: { min, max } } in cm (a null bound = unbounded) — use these to pick a valid widthCm/lengthCm for addToCart instead of guessing.

slug.description: The product slug returned by searchRugs.

tools.name: searchRugs
tools.description: Search the Nylanders rug catalogue by free-text query with optional structured filters. Returns { results, totalMatches } where each result is { productId, name, slug (pass to getRugDetails), url, type, variants }. Each variant has: variantId (opaque id to pass to addToCart); type ('normal' = fixed-size, buy as-is; 'meter' = cut-to-length off a fixed-width roll; 'kvadratmeter' = cut to a custom width×length); colorName; sizeLabel (for normal: 'W x L cm'; for meter: a bare number = the roll width in cm; for kvadratmeter: descriptive, may be 'rund' for round); widthCm/lengthCm (numbers for normal, null for made-to-order since the size is chosen at addToCart); priceExVat and priceIncVat in SEK; currency; inStock (boolean); stockQty (a number, or null meaning quantity is untracked / made-to-order — null means AVAILABLE, not unavailable). Made-to-order variants also carry `constraints` = { width: { min, max }, length: { min, max } } in cm (a null bound = unbounded) — the valid range for the widthCm/lengthCm you pass to addToCart. Filter semantics: `color` matches Swedish catalogue colour names ('Rosa', 'Grön', 'Grå', …); English colour terms are NOT translated or matched, so supply the Swedish name. Width/length range filters apply to fixed-size (normal) variants only; made-to-order (meter/kvadratmeter) variants are NOT excluded by size filters since they can be cut to the requested size. `maxPriceSek` compares against the ex-VAT price. `inStockOnly` defaults true; `limit` defaults 10.

query.description: Free-text search phrase (e.g. a rug name, colour, or style).

color.description: Filter to variants matching this Swedish catalogue colour name (e.g. 'Rosa', 'Grön', 'Grå'). English colour terms are NOT translated or matched.

maxPriceSek.description: Maximum price in SEK, compared against the ex-VAT price.

inStockOnly.description: Only return variants that are in stock. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Maximum number of result products. Defaults to 10.
